conclusion: The model-capability hypothesis is supported: with the same OpenCode Agent, tools and r4 path, Luna satisfied C02-C04 within the frozen limit and C05 behavior also passed. The Qwen observations are retained as measurements of an unsuitable model profile for this task set rather than evidence of an Agent architecture failure.
limitations: The original frozen comparison used Qwen; changing the model makes these follow-up runs non-comparable as evidence of platform-only benefit.
